title: Run through a unary state field
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $src,dst$ be distinct work-tape indices, let $copy$ be a Boolean, and let $d$ be a configuration of the successor-field machine. Suppose $d$ is in the unary phase and the source tape, starting at its head position, contains $s$ ones followed by a zero. For any $r\le s+1$, after $r$ steps the machine is in the configuration with the first $r$ bits of that word copied to the destination tape exactly when copying is enabled; its state is unary if $r\le s$, and done with the live flag true if $r=s+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a configuration of the successor-field machine
the source tape contains $s$ ones followed by zero from its head position
